query: SELECT year, campus, COUNT(DISTINCT weekStartDate) as sundays_with_data, MIN(weekStartDate) as earliest, MAX(weekStartDate) as latest FROM attendance_weekly WHERE year >= 2025 GROUP BY year, campus ORDER BY year, campus;
